# Vendored PixiJS

PixiJS 8.21.0 (MIT), copied from the project's existing Stranded Colony repository, where it is documented as a pinned local dependency.

Source: https://github.com/ErikEhresman-ST1987/stranded-colony/blob/main/vendor/pixi.min.js
Upstream: https://github.com/pixijs/pixijs

Load locally from `index.html`; no runtime CDN is required for PixiJS. Upgrade only after verification.
